    patch:
      tags: [assets]
      operationId: updateAsset
      summary: Change an asset
      x-required: "scope write:assets, role editor"
      description: |
        Partial update. The inventory number cannot change (422 `immutable`); another `category_id` moves the asset (see AssetUpdate). In `fields`, only the sent keys change; `null` clears one.

        - {name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1}}
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/AssetUpdate"}
            example: {status: defective, fields: {length: 20}}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Asset"}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}
        "404": {$ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"}
        "415": {$ref: "#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType"}

        "429": {$ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"}

      tags: [assets]
      operationId: deleteAsset
      summary: Delete an asset
      x-required: "scope write:assets, role admin"
      description: |
        Deletes the asset with its field values and inspections. Retiring an asset (status `retired`) keeps the history and is usually better.

      responses:

  /api/v1/assets/{id}/inspections:
    get:
      tags: [inspections]
      operationId: listAssetInspections
      summary: List the inspections of an asset
      x-required: "scope read:inspections"
      description: |
        Newest first.
      parameters:
        - {name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1}}
        - {name: from, in: query, description: First inspection date (inclusive)., schema: {type: string, format: date}}
        - {name: to, in: query, description: Last inspection date (inclusive)., schema: {type: string, format: date}}
        - {name: result, in: query, schema: {type: string, enum: [pass, fail]}}
        - {$ref: "#/components/parameters/page"}
        - {$ref: "#/components/parameters/per_page"}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/InspectionList"}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}
        "404": {$ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"}
        "429": {$ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"}
        "500": {$ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"}
    post:
      tags: [inspections]
      operationId: createInspection
      summary: Record an inspection
      x-required: "scope write:inspections, owner with can_inspect"
      description: |
        Same rules as the web form: only assets of categories that require DGUV V3 and that are not retired or lost can be inspected (422 `not_inspectable`, `asset_inactive`); the inspection date may not be more than one day in the future; measurements are optional non-negative numbers. `inspected_on` defaults to today (UTC) and `inspector_name` to the token owner. LANventory never derives pass or fail from the measurements; `guidance` lists simplified hints. A failed result sets an active asset to defective when `set_defective` is true; a passed result sets a defective asset back to active when `set_active` is true.
      parameters:
        - {name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1}}
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/InspectionCreate"}
            example: {result: pass, protection_class: I, visual_ok: true, function_ok: true, pe_resistance_ohm: 0.12, insulation_mohm: 20, leakage_ma: 0.4, touch_ma: 0.2, reason: repeat}
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Recorded; the Location header has the URL
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/InspectionCreated"}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}
        "404": {$ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"}
        "415": {$ref: "#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType"}
        "422": {$ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationFailed"}
        "429": {$ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"}
        "500": {$ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"}
      x-codeSamples:
        - lang: curl
          source: "curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"result\":\"pass\",\"visual_ok\":true,\"function_ok\":true}' https://inventory.example/api/v1/assets/12/inspections"

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearer:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: "API token `lvk_...` with the scopes read:assets, write:assets, read:inspections, write:inspections. A browser session works too (header X-CSRF-Token on unsafe methods)."
  parameters:
    page:
      name: page
      in: query
      description: Page number, from 1.
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, default: 1}
    per_page:
      name: per_page
      in: query
      description: Items per page.
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 200, default: 50}
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Invalid query parameter (`invalid_parameter`) or a body that is not one JSON object (`invalid_json`)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    Unauthorized:
      description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired token, disabled owner, or no (complete) session
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    Forbidden:
      description: Missing scope (`insufficient_scope`), the owner's role or rights do not allow it (`forbidden`), CSRF failure (`csrf_failed`) or a required second factor is missing (`mfa_required`)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    NotFound:
      description: No such resource or endpoint
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    Conflict:
      description: The resource is in use
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: The body must be sent as application/json
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    ValidationFailed:
      description: Invalid values (`validation_failed` with `errors`), or the asset cannot be inspected (`not_inspectable`, `asset_inactive`)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
          example: {type: "urn:lanventory:problem:validation_failed", title: Unprocessable Entity, status: 422, code: validation_failed, detail: "the request is well-formed but its values are invalid", errors: {name: required, "fields.length": invalid_number}}
    TooManyRequests:
      description: Rate limit per token exceeded; see Retry-After
      headers:
        Retry-After: {description: Seconds to wait., schema: {type: integer}}
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
    InternalError:
      description: Unexpected server error (details in the server log)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"}
  schemas:
    Problem:
      type: object
      required: [type, title, status, code]
      properties:
        type: {type: string}
        title: {type: string}
        status: {type: integer}
        detail: {type: string}
        code:
          type: string
          description: Stable error code.
          enum: [not_found, invalid_token, unauthorized, insufficient_scope, forbidden, csrf_failed, mfa_required, rate_limited,
                 invalid_parameter, invalid_json, unsupported_media_type, payload_too_large, method_not_allowed, validation_failed,
                 conflict, not_inspectable, asset_inactive, internal]
        errors:
          type: object
          description: Field name to error code (validation_failed only). Custom fields are named `fields.<key>`.
          additionalProperties: {type: string}
    Me:
      type: object
      required: [user, auth, token, effective_scopes]
      properties:
        user:
          type: object
          required: [id, username, role, can_inspect]
          properties:
            id: {type: integer}
            username: {type: string}
            role: {type: string, enum: [viewer, editor, admin]}
            can_inspect: {type: boolean}
        auth: {type: string, enum: [token, session]}
        token:
          description: The token of this request; null for a session.
          oneOf:
            - type: "null"
            - type: object
              required: [id, name, prefix, scopes, expires_at]
              properties:
                id: {type: integer}
                name: {type: string}
                prefix: {type: string}
                scopes: {type: array, items: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Scope"}}
                expires_at: {type: [string, "null"], format: date-time}
        effective_scopes:
          description: The scopes usable right now (token scopes limited by the user's role and flags; for a session all scopes the user's rights allow).
          type: array
          items: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Scope"}
    Scope:
      type: string
      enum: [read:assets, write:assets, read:inspections, write:inspections]
    Location:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, description, asset_count, created_at, updated_at]
      properties:
        id: {type: integer}
        name: {type: string}
        description: {type: string}
        asset_count: {type: integer}
        created_at: {type: string, format: date-time}
        updated_at: {type: string, format: date-time}
    LocationInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:

    AssetUpdate:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      description: Only the sent properties change. `inventory_no` may be sent but must equal the current value. Another `category_id` moves the asset to that category; custom values carry over to fields with the same key when valid, others are dropped, `fields` refer to the new category and its required fields must be filled. The inventory number and the inspections stay.
      properties:
        category_id: {type: integer}
        inventory_no: {type: string}

        serial_no: {type: string}

    Cmp:
      type: string
      enum: ["", "<", ">"]
      description: Comparison qualifier of the reading next to it. ">" means the reading lies above the instrument's range (">299" MOhm), "<" below it; empty means an exact reading. Guidance compares the number as it is.
    Inspection:
      type: object
      required: [id, asset_id, inventory_no, asset_name, category_name, location_name, inspected_on, inspector_name, recorded_by, result,
                 protection_class, visual_ok, function_ok, reason, pe_resistance_ohm, pe_resistance_cmp, insulation_mohm, insulation_cmp,
                 leakage_ma, leakage_cmp, leakage_method, touch_ma, touch_cmp, test_device, test_device_id,
                 test_device_calibrated_until, remark, interval_months, next_due, guidance, created_at]

        inspector_name: {type: string}
        recorded_by: {type: [integer, "null"], description: User ID; null if the user was deleted.}

        protection_class: {type: [string, "null"], enum: [I, II, III, null]}
        visual_ok: {type: boolean}
        function_ok: {type: boolean}

        pe_resistance_ohm: {type: [number, "null"], description: Protective conductor resistance in ohm.}
        pe_resistance_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Cmp"}

        insulation_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Cmp"}

        leakage_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Cmp"}
        leakage_method: {type: string, enum: ["", direct, differential, alternative], description: "Measuring method of the leakage current; empty = not recorded."}
        touch_ma: {type: [number, "null"], description: Touch current in milliampere.}
        touch_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/Cmp"}
        test_device: {type: string}
        test_device_id: {type: string}
        test_device_calibrated_until: {type: [string, "null"], format: date}
        remark: {type: string}

        next_due: {type: string, format: date}

        created_at: {type: string, format: date-time}

    InspectionCreate:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [result]
      properties:
        inspected_on: {type: string, format: date, description: Defaults to today (UTC); at most one day in the future.}
        inspector_name: {type: string, description: Defaults to the token owner; may be an external electrician.}
        result: {type: string, enum: [pass, fail]}
        protection_class: {type: [string, "null"], enum: [I, II, III, null]}
        visual_ok: {type: boolean, default: false}
        function_ok: {type: boolean, default: false}
        reason: {type: [string, "null"], enum: ["", initial, repeat, repair, null]}
        pe_resistance_ohm: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/MeasurementInput"}
        pe_resistance_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/CmpInput"}
        insulation_mohm: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/MeasurementInput"}
        insulation_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/CmpInput"}
        leakage_ma: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/MeasurementInput"}
        leakage_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/CmpInput"}
        leakage_method: {type: [string, "null"], enum: ["", direct, differential, alternative, null]}
        touch_ma: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/MeasurementInput"}
        touch_cmp: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/CmpInput"}
        test_device: {type: string}
        test_device_id: {type: string, maxLength: 100}
        test_device_calibrated_until: {type: [string, "null"], format: date}
        remark: {type: string}
        set_defective: {type: boolean, default: false, description: With a failed result, set an active asset to defective.}
        set_active: {type: boolean, default: false, description: A passed result sets a defective asset back to active.}
    MeasurementInput:
      description: |
        A non-negative reading. Maximum 1000 (ohm, mA) or 10000 (MOhm for insulation). Besides a number, a string is accepted for convenience, with comma or dot decimals and an optional leading `>` or `<` for readings beyond the instrument's range: `">299"`, `"< 0,01"`. The qualifier then sets the matching `*_cmp` property; a contradicting explicit `*_cmp` is rejected.
      oneOf:
        - {type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 10000}
        - {type: string, maxLength: 26}
        - {type: "null"}
    CmpInput:
      type: [string, "null"]
      enum: ["", "<", ">", null]
      description: Comparison qualifier of the reading with the same prefix; only together with a value.
